Hi Laura —

Great to meet you at the SaaS Summit last week — really enjoyed our brief chat about FintechX's fraud-detection pipeline and the latency/cost trade-offs you mentioned. As promised, I wanted to follow up with a quick recap and propose next steps so we can see if Redwood is a fit.

Recap (from our conversation):
- Primary goal: integrate low-latency scoring for transaction-level fraud signals into an existing streaming pipeline.
- Volume: ~200 req/s peak across US during market hours, with burst to 500 for specific events.
- Constraints: strict PII controls, SOC2 + encrypted logs, and predictability on latency (p95 < 120ms).
- Current stack: in-house model (T5 variant), experimenting with quantization.

Potential next steps:
1) Quick 30-min discovery call to map request patterns and SLOs — I can bring Dylan (serving lead) for technical Qs.
2) Demo of Redwood Dedicated (GPU pools + autoscale) and a short perf/cost estimate for your profile.
3) Share SOC2 evidence & integration checklist.

If that sounds good, here are two times I have available next week: Tue 6/23 11:00am PT or Wed 6/24 3:00pm PT — or you can pick a slot: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min.

Attaching a short one-pager and a pricing overview so you have context before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
